title: Lab: Wire Up a CI Pipeline (GitHub Actions)
intro_md: Apply CI/CD concepts in the most accessible tool: create a workflow, watch it fail fast, and inspect runs from the CLI (gh).

steps.instruction_md: Workflows live in a conventional directory. Create `.github/workflows` (with parents).
steps.hint: mkdir with the flag that creates parent directories.

steps.instruction_md: You wrote `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with lint → test → build jobs. Stage it.
Commit it with the message `ci: add pipeline` (double quotes).
steps.mock_output:
[main 4a5b6c7] ci: add pipeline
 1 file changed, 48 insertions(+)

steps.instruction_md: Push to origin main to trigger the workflow.
steps.hint: Push the branch the workflow triggers on.

steps.instruction_md: List recent workflow runs with the GitHub CLI.
steps.mock_output:
STATUS  TITLE             WORKFLOW  BRANCH  EVENT  ID
X       ci: add pipeline  CI        main    push   9182736450

steps.instruction_md: The run failed (fail-fast at lint). Inspect run 9182736450 showing the failing job's log.
steps.mock_output:
lint | src/app.js:12:1 error 'db' is not defined  no-undef
lint | Process completed with exit code 1.
steps.hint: gh run view <id> with the flag that prints only failed steps' logs.

steps.instruction_md: You fixed and pushed; re-run the failed run 9182736450 (only failed jobs).
steps.hint: gh run rerun — optionally scoped to failed jobs.
